verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a programmatic API and an MCP server, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, though it only checked the support.elicit.com domain, and the llms.txt it found is a help-center index rather than an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
